decisions.rationale: The user approved the card-only pin adoption (verbatim: "Approved.") moving this source's catalog pin to the checker-PASS candidate card revision. Verified via Git blob IDs that the candidate differs from the configured pin only in README.md and upstream-license/ license documents; every task/payload file is byte-identical, so the measured censuses carry over. The deterministic checker PASSes the adopted pin (P1). An exception does not transfer to a new revision.
